<subject>Reminder – Final Opportunity to Share Your Thoughts on Naming Our New Childcare Facility</subject>
<body>
Dear Colleagues,

As Meridian Law & Advisory LLP moves forward with plans to open our new childcare facility in the third quarter of next year, we are inviting your feedback on five proposed names/concepts for the centre. If you have already shared your views, thank you very much!

If you haven’t yet had the chance, please take a few minutes to visit our office at 12 Queen’s Court, Room 3B between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM today to share your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague along! Complimentary refreshments will be available.

Please also forward this message to any other Meridian team members who might be interested in contributing their input.

We look forward to welcoming you later today!

Best regards,  
Charlotte Bennett  
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP  
</body>
